_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. Pinned to commit SHAs, not a branch name, as of 0.1.9 -- a branch pin silently picks up whatever that branch's HEAD is at tag-push time, which twice produced a release missing work that had already been committed to the branch but not accounted for when the tag was cut. A SHA pin makes exactly what's bundled explicit and reviewable in this file's own diff. pine-lang's 0.37.1 is now tagged (it wasn't when this was last touched), so pineLangRef points at the tag directly instead of its merge SHA. beamlynx-ui bumped to its merged 0.45.2 (notification bell color correction, on top of 0.45.1's connection-picker fixes) -- not yet in a tagged release -- switch to a real version tag once it is.
